sections.title: Double-Chambered Right Ventricle
details: Discusses surgical outcomes and long-term management for patients with double-chambered right ventricle.

sections.title: Ebstein Anomaly
details: Provides insights into the morphology and outcomes of surgical and medical management.
Focus on accessory pathways and arrhythmias associated with Ebstein's anomaly.

sections.title: Tetralogy of Fallot
details: Covers guidelines and recommendations for the management of patients with Tetralogy of Fallot.
Includes information on surgical repair and management of arrhythmias.
